result.topic_en: Draft passages for Riemann's methodological introduction to the mechanics of the ear: the performance of the hearing organ must first be carefully established, and an explanation can be tested against experience through its consequences and through the physical properties of the organ's parts. The upper half is upright and mostly readable; the lower half is written upside down, heavily struck through and largely illegible.
